generator_consistency_gap.finding: BRIDGE B-006 states the stationary measure is P_ss(i) = d_i/(2|E|) (the degree distribution), proved via Perron-Frobenius on 'the transition matrix.' The ARBS spectral reconstruction already CERTIFIED elsewhere in this project (DER-SPC-002/GEO-001: L=D-A; DER-SPC-004/GEO-003: K_t=exp(-tL)) uses the plain combinatorial graph Laplacian, whose kernel for a connected graph is the CONSTANT vector, i.e. exp(-tL) has the UNIFORM distribution as its stationary state, not the degree distribution -- these coincide only for regular graphs (every vertex the same degree). The ARBS shell graphs G0-G4 are NOT regular (intra- and inter-shell degrees differ substantially across L_k/R_k and across k). Therefore the generator L* used in BRIDGE B-006's entropy-production theorem is not demonstrably the same operator as the certified ARBS Laplacian L, and no source registry entry reconciles the two. This is an independent blocking gap on top of the initial-condition and evaluation-time gaps: even fixing P(0) and t, it is not certain which operator to evolve P(t) under.
generator_consistency_gap.status: OPEN -- not resolved by this run; recorded, not invented around

sign_result.statement: sigma_k > 0 whenever P(t) != P_ss (generic, non-equilibrium case), for ANY admissible generator and initial condition, by the CERTIFIED H-theorem (BRIDGE B-006).
sign_result.consequence: Since delta_spec(G_k) - lambda_c,k < 0 for every k=0..4 (lambda_c,k > lambda_max(L_k) >= delta_spec(G_k), established in the prior run), Pi_0(G_k) = (delta_spec-lambda_c)/sigma_k < 0 for every k=0..4, for ANY admissible sigma_k satisfying the certified sign.

nonidentifiability_demonstration.method: reconstruction/sigma_nonidentifiability_demo.py -- computes sigma(t)=-dF/dt using the CERTIFIED heat semigroup exp(-tL) already used throughout ARBS (resolving GAP-GENERATOR-001 in the single most literal reading available: same L, therefore P_ss=uniform, not the degree distribution B-006 states -- itself only one arbitrary resolution among others), sampled at 2 illustrative initial nodes x 3 illustrative times, across all 5 shells.
nonidentifiability_demonstration.result: argmax_k Pi_0(G_k) takes 3 DIFFERENT values (G0, G1, or G2) across just 6 sampled (P(0),t) combinations; G3 is never the argmax in this sample.
nonidentifiability_demonstration.caveat: This is an illustrative existence proof of parameter-dependence, not a claim about what the 'true' ranking is under any specific canonical choice -- no such canonical choice exists in the source material.
